QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_57

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines the Treynor Ratio as excess return over the risk-free rate per unit of systematic risk, measured by portfolio beta, with formula (Rp - Rf) / beta. Sharpe, by contrast, divides excess return by the portfolio's standard deviation. The Trap: Standard deviation is the Sharpe denominator. Maximum drawdown and VaR-based ratios are different risk measures and do not appear in the Treynor formula. Note: Per workbook pages 222-224.
